info.title: AstraWatch Orchestrator API
info.description: Official OpenAPI 3.0 specification for AstraWatch autonomous telemetry, anomaly detection, incident orchestration, and K8s self-healing microservices.

post.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns JWT access + refresh tokens.
Registers a new user account.
Refreshes JWT access token using a valid refresh token.
Logs out the current user session.

get.description: Returns current authenticated user profile, roles, and permissions.

post.description: Triggers a password reset email workflow.
Resets password using a valid reset token.
Initializes TOTP MFA and returns QR code URL and backup codes.
Verifies a TOTP code and enables MFA on the account.

get.description: Lists all active login sessions for the current user.

delete.description: Terminates a specific session by ID.

post.description: Generates a new API key for programmatic access.

get.description: Lists all API keys for the current user/org.

post.description: Invites a user to the platform by email.
Switches active team/org scope and issues a new scoped token.
Creates a new incident with severity level, affected service, and description.

get.description: Lists all incidents, optionally filtered by service.
Fetches detailed view of a single incident including assignment and state.

post.description: Assigns incident ownership to a user.
Resolves an incident with a resolution note. Transitions state to RESOLVED.
Escalates incident to specified user or on-call tier.

get.description: Fetches the full timeline event log for an incident.

patch.description: Triggers a Spring StateMachine lifecycle event to transition incident state.

post.description: Triggers an automated or manual remediation healing workflow for an incident. Risk score determines if approval is required.
Approves execution of a pending healing action.
Executes a rollback for a previously applied healing action.

get.description: Returns historical record of all executed healing actions.
Evaluates before/after metric comparison to validate healing effectiveness.
Lists all notification channels (Slack, PagerDuty, Email, Webhook).

post.description: Creates a new notification destination channel.
Dispatches a test notification to verify channel integration.

get.description: Lists scheduled maintenance windows for notification suppression.
Retrieves personal notification preferences for a user.
Returns SLO metrics: current attainment percentage, error budget remaining, and burn rate.

post.description: Defines a new Service Level Objective for a service.

get.description: Lists all automated runbooks, optionally filtered by service.

post.description: Creates a new executable runbook with step definitions.
Asynchronously triggers execution of a runbook with parameters.

get.description: Retrieves full status page: component statuses, active incidents, and uptime percentage.

post.description: Adds a new component to the status page.

put.description: Updates a component's operational status on the status page.

post.description: Creates a postmortem document for a resolved incident.

get.description: Retrieves the postmortem report for an incident.

post.description: Exports the postmortem to Markdown or PDF format.
Creates a new on-call rotation schedule.

get.description: Lists all synthetic monitoring probes (HTTP, DNS, TCP).

post.description: Configures a new synthetic monitoring probe with assertions.
